title: Forome Genetic Evidence Model (GEM)
description: A semantic model for scientific and genetic evidence from the biomedical literature, designed to support variant interpretation and AI-ready clinical infrastructure. The repository provides the schema (SHACL shapes), an annotation corpus of six publications spanning human, population, model-organism and polygenic-score genetics, the extraction pipeline that transforms PDF-level annotations into structured YAML, a curated term-level UMLS crosswalk of the dimensional vocabulary, and the GEM Mapping Studio, a standalone curation tool for defining mapping axes and adjudicating value-level mappings.
